description: This file defines interfaces and classes for communicating with secure hardware components related to Android's identity hardware. It includes proxy factory, provisioning, and presentation proxy classes, along with their methods for initialization, credential management, key generation, and session handling.

classes.name: SecureHardwareProxyFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating secure hardware proxies for provisioning and presentation sessions.

classes.name: SecureHardwareProvisioningProxy
classes.description: Interface for provisioning-related operations with secure hardware, including credential creation and entry management.

classes.name: SecureHardwarePresentationProxy
classes.description: Interface for presentation-related operations with secure hardware, including key generation, session management, and access control validation.

methods.name: createProvisioningProxy
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning proxy instance.

methods.name: createPresentationProxy
methods.description: Creates a new presentation proxy instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning proxy with a test credential flag.

methods.name: initializeForUpdate
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning proxy for update with document type and encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: createCredentialKey
methods.description: Creates a credential key with a challenge and application ID, returning a certificate chain.

methods.name: startPersonalization
methods.description: Starts personalization with access control profiles and document type.

methods.name: addAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile, returning a MAC.

methods.name: beginAddEntry
methods.description: Begins adding an entry with specified access control profiles.

methods.name: addEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an entry, returning encrypted content.

methods.name: finishAddingEntries
methods.description: Completes adding entries, returning a signature.

methods.name: finishGetCredentialData
methods.description: Completes credential data retrieval, returning credential keys.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the proxy.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the presentation proxy with credentials and document type.

methods.name: generateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a signing key pair, returning public key and signing key blob.

methods.name: createEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral private key.

methods.name: createAuthChallenge
methods.description: Creates an authentication challenge.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntries
methods.description: Begins retrieval of entries.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets an authentication token with challenge, user ID, and other parameters.

methods.name: pushReaderCert
methods.description: Pushes a reader certificate.

methods.name: validateAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Validates an access control profile.

methods.name: validateRequestMessage
methods.description: Validates a request message.

methods.name: calcMacKey
methods.description: Calculates a MAC key for session.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Starts retrieval of an entry value.

methods.name: retrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves an entry value.

methods.name: finishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes retrieval of an entry value.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a credential.

methods.name: proveOwnership
methods.description: Proves ownership of a credential.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the presentation proxy.
